_comment: Chest ImaGenome GOLD set: 1,000 manually verified chest X-rays with merged ground-truth anatomical bounding boxes and per-region findings. An annotation layer over MIMIC-CXR (PhysioNet, credentialed access + DUA); ships no pixels. Images are read from the MIMIC-CXR DICOM tree, keyed by dicom_id. Source: https://physionet.org/content/chest-imagenome/1.0.0/
base_image_dir: MIMIC-CXR DICOM files/ root (children are p10/, p11/, ...), e.g. /data/MIMIC-CXR-V2-AWS/files/

primary_csv._comment: Not a single CSV; the harmonizer reads annotation files under annotation_dir. Boxes: gold_dataset/gold_bbox_coordinate_annotations_1000images.csv (one row per image+region).

patient_id._comment: Resolved from utils/cxr-record-list_view.csv by joining on dicom_id.

study_id._comment: Resolved from utils/cxr-record-list_view.csv by joining on dicom_id.

image_path._comment: From the record-list 'path' column; 'files/' stripped so it is relative to base_image_dir (the DICOM files/ root). Ends in .dcm.

labels._comment: No image-level classification vector. Findings are PER BOX (see bboxes/custom_preprocessing), not aggregated to image level.

separate_csv._comment: Per-region findings come from gold_dataset/gold_object_attribute_with_coordinates.txt (relation 'yes'); joined per (dicom_id, region).

uncertain_handling._comment: Only positive (relation 'yes') findings in categories anatomicalfinding/disease/tubesandlines/device are kept; nlp and technicalassessment excluded.

view_position._comment: AP/PA/LATERAL from the record-list view CSV.

bboxes._comment: Up to 26 anatomical-region boxes per image (all regions, including finding-free ones). Stored as parallel per-box lists: bbox (normalized [y_min,y_max,x_min,x_max]), bbox_labels (anatomy region name), bbox_findings (that region's findings, '|'-joined). Coords normalized against original DICOM Rows/Columns.

extra_init_params.annotation_dir: Chest ImaGenome release root (contains gold_dataset/, utils/), e.g. /data/CHEST-IMAGENOME/
extra_init_params.output_bbox: Default True; boxes are this dataset's sole annotation.

custom_preprocessing: Per-box findings are carried in the harmonized 'bbox_findings' column via the harmonizer's EXTRA_OUTPUT_COLS (anatomy in bbox_labels, findings in bbox_findings) - NOT aggregated to an image-level cls vector. The dataset sets SUPPORTS_BBOX_FINDINGS=True, so with output_bbox=True all three (bbox, bbox_labels, bbox_findings) are threaded into each sample, index-aligned through augmentation; the app labels each box 'anatomy: findings'. Bbox normalization reads original DICOM dimensions (Rows=H, Columns=W) from the header, cached. MIMIC-derived, PhysioNet data: never commit the harmonized DataFrame, saved CSVs, or images.
